scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:game-engine: npm run build:shared && npm run --workspace=@bingo/game-engine build
scripts.build:api: npm run build:game-engine && npm run --workspace=api build
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:game-engine && npm run --workspace=api dev
scripts.test: npm run test:game-engine && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: npm run build:game-engine && npm run --workspace=api test
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: npm run --workspace=api exec -- prisma migrate deploy
